description: A sitar with nineteen synthesised strings: a plucked melody string, a drone, two tuned strings, thirteen sympathetic strings and a pair of chikaris

params.text: Strums the main, jora, second and third strings
Switched on, a change of pitch with no new strum bends the main string up or down to the new note instead of plucking it
Sets the level of the main string, the one the melody is plucked on; all the way down the string is switched off altogether and stops costing processor time
Sets the level of the jora string, the drone tuned to the root; all the way down the string is switched off altogether and stops costing processor time
Sets the level of the second string; all the way down the string is switched off altogether and stops costing processor time
Sets the level of the third string; all the way down the string is switched off altogether and stops costing processor time
Sets the level of the taraf strings that ring sympathetically; all the way down the string is switched off altogether and stops costing processor time
Sets the level of the chikari strings; all the way down the string is switched off altogether and stops costing processor time
Plucks the two chikari strings, which are tuned to the root an octave apart
Switches the Sa sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Re flat sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Re sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Ga flat sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Ga sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Ma sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Ma sharp sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Pa sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Dha flat sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Dha sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Ni flat sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the Ni sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Switches the upper Sa sympathetic string in or out of the set that rings when the main string matches it; it glows while that string is ringing
Sets the root note the whole instrument is tuned to, named as a Western note; its travel reaches C to B flat and stops short of B
Sets the note the second string is tuned to, named in the Indian sargam; its travel reaches Sa to Ni flat and stops short of Ni
Sets the note the third string is tuned to, named in the Indian sargam; its travel reaches Sa to Ni flat and stops short of Ni
Runs a finger across every enabled taraf string in turn

inputs.text: A rising edge past 2V strums the main, jora, second and third strings
Sets the pitch of the main string, a volt per octave, and only between -1V and +2V
A rising edge past 2V plucks the two chikari strings
Adds to the main string fader, 10V covering the whole of its travel
Adds to the jora string fader, 10V covering the whole of its travel
Adds to the second string fader, 10V covering the whole of its travel
Adds to the third string fader, 10V covering the whole of its travel
Adds to the taraf strings fader, 10V covering the whole of its travel
Adds to the chikari strings fader, 10V covering the whole of its travel
Transposes the root note of the whole instrument, a volt per octave rounded to the nearest semitone, and only between -1V and +2V
Transposes the second string on its own, a volt per octave rounded to the nearest semitone, and only between -1V and +2V
Transposes the third string on its own, a volt per octave rounded to the nearest semitone, and only between -1V and +2V
A rising edge past 2V runs a finger across the enabled taraf strings, despite the maker's tooltip calling it Taraf string tuning

notes: nothing sounds until a strum arrives, from the STRUM jack or the button beside it
the tarafs are never plucked by an ordinary strum; they ring only when the main string lands on their pitch, or when the taraf strum is used
